Fantastic food and service
Apr 2026 • Couples
We had dinner here a few nights ago and it was fantastic.

When we arrived, we were greeted by a lovely young waiter who looked after us throughout the evening. The menu offered a great variety of options, including fish, chicken, pork, and vegetarian dishes.

I ordered the Hanoi Traditional Fried Pork, while my partner chose the Stir-Fried Chicken with cashews. When my meal arrived, the waiter asked if I knew how to assemble all the elements. When I said I wasn’t sure, he kindly showed me the traditional way to put it together and enjoy it, which really added to the experience.

We also ordered two serves of spring rolls and finished with two desserts—a banana crepe and caramelised banana with orange and ice cream.

Everything we had was delicious. The standout dishes were the spring rolls, the Hanoi Traditional Fried Pork, and the caramelised banana with orange and ice cream.

The service was outstanding, and our waiter made the experience even more enjoyable. The meals were beautifully presented, prepared with care, and arrived without a long wait.

I’d highly recommend adding this place to your must-visit dining spots in Ho Chi Minh City.
